description: This file is a PHP source code defining a class 'Category' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Event'. It handles events related to category operations such as add, edit, and delete, by adding tasks to the task management system within an OpenCart admin controller context.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Controller class that manages event hooks for category operations in the admin panel, adding asynchronous tasks to manage category data updates.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Handles the event after a category is added by scheduling tasks to update category lists and information.

methods.name: editCategory
methods.description: Handles the event after a category is edited by scheduling tasks to update category lists and specific category info based on provided arguments.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Handles the event after a category is deleted by scheduling tasks to update category lists and remove the specific category.
